briefings.message: Noah Cameron is the high-confidence predicted starter. Stay patient and make him work—he averages 92 pitches per start and 5.2 innings per start. Don’t chase his changeup or curveball, especially below the zone.
reminders: Keep the approved batting order and stay ready for the bullpen.
